verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework that installs locally with `cargo install proa-cli`, scaffolds apps, and runs its own Axum server on your machine. The core crates are in a public GitHub repo and can be adapted to other HTTP servers or runtimes, so the core runs on infrastructure you control. Self-hosting depth is unproven: the evidence never states an open-source license and shows no production deployment guidance beyond local dev and CDN cache headers. missing for 10: explicit open-source license, documented production self-hosting/deployment guide, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted production use
